decision.observation: The car is on grass just below the tarmac at 2 mph in gear 1, all dots dark; the road runs diagonally across the top of the screen with puddles, and cones/a yellow tent sit on the far grass to the upper right. A tall pine stands to the car's left.
decision.hypothesis: The road lies directly ahead and slightly above the car, so plain forward throttle should carry it onto the tarmac without steering into the pine on the left.
decision.memory: Left steering here brought the car near a pine; the road edge is straight ahead and just up-screen. Plain throttle has mounted the road reliably when aligned.
